newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Hanbo Const put under court receivership.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Hanbo Const put under court receivership.

text.p: A Seoul District Court on Monday put Hanbo Engineering and Construction Co under protection from its creditors, a court official said.
"The court approved an application by Hanbo for receivership," the official said. "Further details will be released later."
Hanbo Engineering and Construction, an unlisted unit of financially troubled Hanbo Group, filed for court receivership in March.
Hanbo Engineering faced financial difficulties after the group's flagship Hanbo Steel collapsed in January under debts of five trillion won. ($1 = 898 won) -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5647
